info.name: Nahata Sports - Employee Panel - Coaching Enquiries API
info.description:
Every API behind **Dashboard > Coaching Enquiries** in the Employee panel
(`/dashboard/coaching-enquiries`).

---

## Base URL
Set the `baseUrl` collection variable - it already ends in `/api`.
- Local: `http://localhost:5050/api`
- Production: confirm the API host with the backend team

---

## Auth
1. Run **00 - Auth > Login (Employee)** first; its test script stores the
   tokens into the collection variables.
2. Everything else inherits `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}` from the
   collection.

Employees log in on `portal: "main"` (the website), not `"admin"`.

---

## Two gates on every request
| Gate | Effect |
|---|---|
| Role | `ADMIN`, `COMPLEX_ADMIN` and `EMPLOYEE` may call these routes |
| Module permission | An EMPLOYEE additionally needs `employee_coaching_enquiries` granted in Roles Management, else 403 |

**Complex scoping** - an EMPLOYEE only ever sees and touches their own
`sportComplexId`. The server forces it on reads and writes, so never send
`sportComplexId` from the client.

---

## Screen to endpoint

| UI element | Endpoint |
|---|---|
| Table, count, Filters, Refresh | `GET /coaching-enquiries/all` |
| Export Excel | the same endpoint at `limit=1000` - the file is built in the browser |
| + Add Enquiry | `POST /coaching-enquiries/admin/create` |
| Pencil (edit) | `PUT /coaching-enquiries/admin/:id` |
| View / Approve | `POST /coaching-enquiries/:id/approve-and-enroll` |
| Status change without enrolling | `PATCH /coaching-enquiries/:id/status` |
| Bin (delete) | `DELETE /coaching-enquiries/:id` |
| Sport / Batch / Coach dropdowns | `GET /sports`, `GET /batches`, `GET /coaches` |

---

## Response envelope
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "...", "data": { } }
```
A `500` adds an `error` key with the technical detail. Branch on the HTTP
status, then show `message`.

## Status codes
| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 200 / 201 | OK / Created |
| 400 | Validation - missing field, bad email, bad status value, batch full, already approved |
| 401 | Missing / expired token, or the staff account was disabled or deleted |
| 403 | Wrong role, module permission not granted, or a record in another complex |
| 404 | Enquiry not found |
| 500 | Server error - includes the 10-digit phone rule violation |

variable.description: API host INCLUDING /api. No trailing slash.
The employee account used by Login.
Set automatically by List Enquiries / Add Enquiry.

item.name: 00 - Auth
item.description: Run Login first. Employees authenticate on the website portal (`portal: "main"`).

request.description:
Employees sign in on the WEBSITE portal, so `portal` must be `"main"`.
Only ADMIN / COMPLEX_ADMIN use `"admin"`; sending `"admin"` here returns 403.

`identifier` accepts an email OR a 10-digit phone number (`email` is still
accepted as a legacy alias for it).

The test script stores `accessToken` / `refreshToken` into the collection
variables, so every other request in this collection just works after this one.

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 200 | Logged in |
| 400 | identifier or password missing |
| 401 | Wrong credentials, or the staff account was deleted / disabled |
| 403 | Wrong portal for this role |

item.name: 01 - Coaching Enquiries
item.description:
Employee permission id: `employee_coaching_enquiries`.

**All Sports** - send `isAllSports: true` (or `sportId: "all"`) and omit
sport / batch / coach to file the enquiry against the whole complex. Every
sports coach there sees it, and each can assign their own batch and enrol the
same student; the enquiry stays open until closed by hand.

**Auto-registration** - creating an enquiry registers the student: a User +
Student are created when the email is new, and credentials are emailed. The
response carries `studentAccount: { userId, studentId, isNewAccount }`.

**enrolments[]** - each listed enquiry carries every batch the student is
actually enrolled in, with `sportName`, `coachName`, `batchName` and `status`.
One student can train under several coaches across several sports.

query.description: 1-based page number. Default 1.
Rows per page. The panel uses 10.
Pending | Reviewed | Contacted | Approved | Rejected. Empty = All.
LIKE match on name, email OR phone - the single Search box.
createdAt >= this. A plain yyyy-mm-dd date is fine.
createdAt <= this. MUST carry T23:59:59.999 - see the description.
Optional extra filter, not exposed in the UI.
Optional extra filter, not exposed in the UI.

request.description:
Backs the whole table, the header count (`data.total`), the Filters bar and Refresh.

**Response shape**
```
data = { enquiries: [...], total, page, limit, totalPages }
```

**toDate gotcha** - `toDate` is compared against `createdAt`, a *timestamp*. A bare
`2026-09-02` means `00:00:00`, so everything logged during that day is excluded.
The panel always appends `T23:59:59.999`. Do the same.

**Complex scoping** - an EMPLOYEE token is forced to its own `sportComplexId`;
there is no client-side way to widen it.

**enrolments[]** - every row carries what the student is ACTUALLY enrolled in
(`batchId`, `batchName`, `sportId`, `sportName`, `coachId`, `coachName`, `status`),
which can span several sports and coaches. The enquiry's own `batch` / `sport` /
`coach` is only what was asked for. This is what the ENROLLED UNDER column shows,
and it is empty until the enquiry is approved.

**isAllSports** - true means the enquiry was filed against the whole complex with
no sport / batch / coach; render it as *All Sports*.

request.description:
The **Export Excel** button is NOT a separate API. The panel re-calls this same
list endpoint with the current filters at `page=1&limit=1000`, then builds the
file in the browser from the rows it gets back.

Exported columns: #, Reference, Student Name, Email, Phone, Sport, Batch, Coach,
Enrolled Sports, Enrolled Coaches, Enrolled Batches, Status, Message, Date & Time.

Mind the 1000-row ceiling - past that you have to page.

The **+ Add Enquiry** drawer.

**Required**: `name`, `email`, `phone` - plus `batchId` unless `isAllSports` is
true. `sportId` and `coachId` are derived from the batch when omitted.

**phone must be exactly 10 digits** (no `+91`, no spaces). A violation surfaces as
a 500 with `error: "Validation error: Phone number must be exactly 10 digits"`, so
strip non-digits client-side.

**The email is the student's identity.** Do not send the staff member's own
`userId` - the server matches an existing User by email and that always wins.

**Side effects**: a User + Student are created when the email is new and login
credentials are emailed to the student; a reference number `NSC-YYYYMMDD-XXXXX` is
generated; `status` starts at `Pending`; `sportComplexId` is derived from the
batch; a bell notification fires to the admins. Mail failures never fail the call.

Read `studentAccount.isNewAccount` to tell staff whether a fresh account was made.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Ravi Deshmukh",
  "email": "ravi.deshmukh@example.com",
  "phone": "9876543210",
  "sportId": 19,
  "batchId": 53,
  "coachId": 23,
  "message": "Walk-in enquiry taken at the desk"
}

response.name: 201 - Created

request.description:
What the Sport dropdown's **All Sports** option sends: no sport, no batch, no coach.

The enquiry is filed against the complex, so every sports coach there sees it and
each can assign their own batch and enrol the same student. It is never auto-closed
by one approval - it stays open until the status is changed by hand.

Either send `isAllSports: true`, or the sentinel `"sportId": "all"` - the API
accepts both.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Undecided Walk-in",
  "email": "walkin@example.com",
  "phone": "9876543210",
  "isAllSports": true,
  "message": "Has not picked a sport yet"
}

request.description:
Every field is optional - only what you send is changed.

Moving the enquiry to another `batchId` re-derives sport, coach AND complex from
that batch. Send `batchId` alone, with no `sportId` / `coachId`, to let the batch
decide both.

**Approved enquiries cannot be edited** (400). An approval has already produced a
User, a Student and a batch enrolment, and editing here would not move any of
them - so the API refuses rather than let the two drift apart.

Changing `email` re-points the enquiry at whichever User owns that address.

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 200 | Updated |
| 400 | Blank name/phone, bad email, unknown batch, or already Approved |
| 403 | The enquiry or the target batch belongs to another complex |
| 404 | No such enquiry |

request.description:
Move an enquiry along without enrolling anybody.

`status` must be one of `Pending`, `Reviewed`, `Contacted`, `Approved`, `Rejected`.
Anything else is a 400.

Setting `Rejected` fires a rejection email to the student (fire-and-forget).

Use **Approve & Enroll** rather than setting `Approved` here - this route only
flips the flag, it does NOT create the student or the enrolment.

The **View / Approve** drawer's green action. Runs in one transaction:

1. Finds or creates the User (a brand-new one gets a generated password),
2. Finds or creates the Student record,
3. Enrols them into the enquiry's batch and bumps `currentStudents`,
4. Marks the enquiry `Approved`,
5. Emails the approval - plus the login credentials when the account is new.

The body is entirely optional; the defaults are shown.

For an **All Sports** enquiry there is no batch on the record - the enrolment goes
into the calling coach's own assignment, and the enquiry stays open so the other
coaches can each take the same student.

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 200 | Approved and enrolled |
| 400 | Already approved, no batch on the enquiry, or the batch is full |
| 403 | Enquiry belongs to another complex |
| 404 | No such enquiry |

The UI greys the button out when `batch.currentStudents >= batch.maxStudents`; the
API enforces it too.

request.description:
Soft delete - `deletedAt` is stamped, the row is never dropped.

A complex-scoped employee can only delete inside their own complex; anything else
is a 403. Returns 404 when the id does not exist.

Deleting an approved enquiry does NOT undo the enrolment it produced.

item.name: 02 - Form dropdowns
item.description:
The three lists the Add / Edit drawer loads once, in parallel. All are already
filtered to the employee's own complex.

Each wraps its rows differently, so unwrap defensively:
`json.data?.[key] ?? json.data ?? []`.

request.description:
Fills the Sport dropdown in the Add / Edit drawer.
Returns `data: [ ...sports ]` with a SIBLING `pagination` object.
The panel prepends its own **All Sports** sentinel option client-side.

Fills the Batch dropdown. Returns
`data: { batches, currentPage, totalPages, totalItems, itemsPerPage }`.

Already scoped to the employee's own complex - and the create/update routes reject
a batch from any other complex, so this list is the whole scope story for the form.

Fills the Coach dropdown. Returns
`data: { coaches, currentPage, totalPages, totalItems, itemsPerPage }`.

Optional on the form - left empty, the coach is taken from the chosen batch.
